propositions: fetcher.py exceeds 771 lines and approaches the 800-line module size gate, requiring reduction before incoming query-construction changes
pagination cluster (_ACLI_CEILING, SilentTruncationError, _extract_issues, _iter_pages, collect) forms a self-contained call chain with no upward dependencies and must be extracted to fetch_paging.py
four moved names must be re-exported from fetcher.py to satisfy ~48 existing test and docstring references that access them as fetcher attributes
three resident symbols (_DONE_RECENT_CAP, _load_acli, _load_alert_store) must remain in fetcher.py because tests patch them as module attributes and changing location breaks patch resolution
extraction is behaviour-preserving and verified by existing test suite passing unchanged with attribute presence and patch-survival assertions
